        // vpkstuff patch: the limits vrf-kv3-size-guard and its siblings hold a KV3 block to: the
        // bytes it declares it decompresses to, and the values it may build. A host parsing
        // untrusted files lowers them per async flow (AsyncLocal: it does not flow back out of an
        // async method that opened it, nor through UnsafeQueueUserWorkItem or SuppressFlow).
        /// <summary>512 MB: the largest real block measured is 303,244,222 bytes (de_boulder's world_physics PHYS).</summary>
        public const long DefaultMaxUncompressedBytes = 512L << 20;

        /// <summary>16M (16,777,216). The most values counted in a real block is 5,351,200 (de_boulder's world_physics PHYS), every node and typed-array element included; a value costs about 85 bytes of memory.</summary>
        public const long DefaultMaxValues = 16L << 20;

        private static readonly System.Threading.AsyncLocal<(long Bytes, long Values)?> readLimits = new();

        /// <summary>The byte limit in force: the innermost <see cref="UseReadLimits"/>, else the default.</summary>
        public static long MaxUncompressedBytes => readLimits.Value?.Bytes ?? DefaultMaxUncompressedBytes;

        /// <summary>The value limit in force: the innermost <see cref="UseReadLimits"/>, else the default.</summary>
        public static long MaxValues => readLimits.Value?.Values ?? DefaultMaxValues;

        /// <summary>Lower both limits for this async flow until the result is disposed; never raises either.</summary>
        public static IDisposable UseReadLimits(long maxUncompressedBytes, long maxValues)
        {
            ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfNegative(maxUncompressedBytes);
            ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfNegative(maxValues);
            var outer = readLimits.Value;
            readLimits.Value = (Math.Min(maxUncompressedBytes, MaxUncompressedBytes), Math.Min(maxValues, MaxValues));
            return new LimitScope(outer);
        }

        private sealed class LimitScope((long Bytes, long Values)? outer) : IDisposable
        {
            private bool disposed;

            public void Dispose()
            {
                if (disposed)
                {
                    return;
                }

                disposed = true;
                readLimits.Value = outer;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="BinaryKV3"/> class with DATA block type.
